Habitat: Open fields, hay meadows, prairies, plains. Nests are in grassy bowls on ground.
Foods: 50% animals: insects, spiders, centipedes, oats, sunflower, wheat.
Miscellaneous: Includes: bobolink and western meadowlark.
Name: Family Icteridae (partial)
Montana resident in: Summer, winter.
Habitat: Fresh marshes, tules, swamps-forages in open areas. Nest of woven plant fibers suspended above water in tules.
Foods: 50% plants: insects, snails, crustaceans, spiders, oats, corn, ragweed, wheat, sunflower, dandelion.
Miscellaneous: Includes: yellow-headed and red winged blackbirds.
Name: Family Icteridae (partial)
Montana resident in: Summer, winter.
Habitat: Orchards, farms, towns, shade trees, open woods, lakeshores, parks. Nest are grasslined pouch suspended from tree or a cup on ground (Brewers blackbird).
Foods: Mostly animal: insects, spiders, snails, corn oats, wheat, sunflower, dandelion, berries.
Miscellaneous: Includes: Brewer's blackbird, Orchard and Northern (Baltimore) Orioles.
Name: Family Icteridae (partial)
Montana resident in: Summer.
Habitat: Croplands, towns, streamsides, stock yards, farms. Cowbird lay their eggs in other birds nest. Grackles build nest in tree, reeds, hollows.
Foods: 50/50. Insects, spiders, myriapods, crustaceans, worms, snails, toads, mice, bird eggs, ragweed, oats, wheat, corn, sunflower.
Miscellaneous: Includes: common grackle and brown-headed cowbird.
Name: Western Tanager - Piranga ludoviciana
Montana resident in: Summer.
Habitat: Open conifer or mixed forest. Nest in shallow bowl of oak, pine or fir.
Foods: Insects plus fruits of various trees.
Name: Grosbeaks - Family Fringillidae (partial)
Montana resident in: Summer, winter.
Habitat: Conifer forests. Nests are loose, low cups in conifers.
Foods: Mostly seed and fruits, also insects, spiders.
Miscellaneous: Includes: evening and pine grosbeaks.
Name: Buntings - Family Fringillidae (partial)
Montana resident in: Summer.
Habitat: Sagebrush, brushy slopes, streamsides. Nests are loosly formed cup in brush.
Foods: Insects, seeds of weeds, grasses. Miscellaneous: Includes: lazuli bunting.
